fields.value: Silkworm is a classic horizontally-scrolling shoot-em-up. The main difference between this game and many other side-scrolling shoot-em-ups is that you will be on land as well as in the air. The first player would play as a helicopter, but if a second player joins the game, they would play as a jeep. Both players would have to protect each other as well as themselves. After a certain number of kills, a "goose" helicopter would form on the screen. If the players managed to destroy it they would get a weapon's powerup. This would go on throughout the entire game, and a "goose" could appear even during the fight with the end-of-level baddie.

Silkworm es un clásico shoot 'em up de desplazamiento horizontal. La principal diferencia con muchos otros shoot 'em ups de desplazamiento lateral es que te moverás tanto en tierra como en el aire. El primer jugador controla un helicóptero, pero si se une un segundo jugador, este controlará un jeep. Ambos deberán protegerse mutuamente y a sí mismos. Tras cierto número de enemigos derribados, aparece en pantalla un helicóptero "ganso". Si los jugadores logran destruirlo, obtienen un potenciador de armas. Esto se repite durante todo el juego, e incluso un "ganso" puede aparecer durante la pelea contra el jefe de final de nivel.
